filter_trace_events_by_iteration: create an IterationFilter to extract trace events for specific iteration numbers from a DataFrame
filter_trace_events_by_rank: create a RankFilter to extract trace events for specific rank IDs from a DataFrame
filter_trace_events_by_time_range: create a TimeRangeFilter to extract trace events within a given start and end time interval
filter_gpu_kernel_events: create a GPUKernelFilter to extract GPU kernel and CUDA synchronization events from a trace DataFrame
combine_multiple_trace_filters: create a CompositeFilter to apply a sequence of filters to a trace DataFrame in order
